name: relocoff
description: AN OFFSET RELOCATION NAMING A SEGMENT THE IMAGE DOES NOT HAVE IS REFUSED WITH ENOEXEC.  The fixture is relocseg's /bin/true with its first relocation's source restored to segment 0 and its target byte set to $89: FGX2_RELOC_ADDOFF ($80) on segment 9.  The loader masks the kind bit and checks the segment against the image's count, as it checks a bank relocation's (apple/fgx#522); unchecked, it would add a page read past _ldSegPage.  ldd execs the image and perror()s the failure (bin/ldd.c).
